title: airgap: add helm umbrella packager + offline preflight validations
author: Priya Khandelwal
release_notes: Adds a Helm umbrella packager that produces single distributable bundles and an offline preflight binary that validates host OS, package indices, and local registry certs. No breaking changes to existing installer CLI flags.
description:
Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private in fully air-gapped on-prem environments asked for a simpler way to distribute a single installer bundle that can install multiple helm charts with deterministic ordering, and for stronger preflight checks that run without Internet access. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: (1) a Helm umbrella packager that converts a set of charts and CRDs into a single tar/OCI-compatible bundle with an index and deterministic install order, and (2) an offline preflight validator that runs in the installer stage to assert host/kernel prerequisites, local package indices (apt/yum/dnf shrinkwrap), KMS endpoint reachability (when using proxy), local registry certificate/thumbprint verification, and CRD/apply-sanity checks. The description below is a continuous narrative and includes checklist, testing, and rollout notes.

What this changes: 1) installer/packager: new command `redwood-installer pack-airgap` which accepts a directory of helm charts and outputs a single signed bundle (tar.gz) and a small index.json used by the installer at runtime. The packager supports optional per-chart metadata for installation hooks ordering and can produce an OCI layout for registries that support OCI distribution in air-gapped networks. 2) installer/preflight: new static binary `airgap-preflight` that is invoked during `redwood-installer apply --airgap` (or as an init container when using the installer image). It performs checks offline: kernel params (fs.inotify,max_map_count, cgroups v1/v2 presence), reachable IPs for on-prem KMS endpoints, presence and validity of local registry TLS CA, apt/yum/dnf shrinkwrap consistency (index files present and checksums match), and validates that all required CRDs are present in the bundle before any Helm release is applied. 3) terraform/modules/registry-mirror: add optional `index_snapshot` output to allow mirrors to export a compact index file used by the packager. 4) docs/airgap: new README and quickstart for packager + preflight usage and example CI job to produce signed bundles.

Checklist (completed): - [x] packager prototype and CLI (signing via GPG or ephemeral signing key) - [x] offline preflight binary with host and bundle checks - [x] integration test harness (local registry + k3s) - [x] docs + quickstart + release notes - [x] terraform mirror index support - [x] unit tests for packager index generation

Backward compatibility and upgrades: Existing airgap bundles continue to work; installer detects legacy bundles and falls back to the prior unpack flow. The packager output includes a `legacy_compat` flag when created from an old layout. No changes to default CLI flags required.

Security notes: packager supports signing bundles; the installer verifies signatures by default in the enterprise installer mode. The preflight binary deliberately errs on the side of conservative failure (prevents partial installs). Customers can opt into a `--allow-preflight-warnings` flag during experimentation.

Testing and CI: CI runs packager unit tests and a matrix smoke e2e that exercises the preflight in an offline environment (simulated by firewall rules) and then runs a full chart install using the umbrella index. There was one intermittent e2e failure in the first run related to KMS DNS resolution in our CI network; we added an explicit mock KMS host to the test container and reran. All checks pass now.

Rollout notes: enable feature by default for new airgap bundles; existing customers must re-pack to take advantage of signing and preflight improvements. Provide migration script `redwood-installer migrate-bundle --to=umbrella` to re-index older tar bundles.

Related: SUP-2291 (support request for simpler offline bundle distribution), ENG-4128 (packager implementation), ENG-4139 (preflight checks and CI harness).

review_comments: Ethan Bloom: Overall looks good. Two notes: (1) can we make the preflight timeouts configurable? I hit a 10s DNS timeout causing false negatives in CI. (2) please add a short note in the release docs about the signing key rotation procedure.
Priya Khandelwal: Added `--preflight-timeout` option and documented signing key rotation in docs/airgap/packager-quickstart.md. Also added mock-kms to CI to stabilize the DNS flake.
Sofia Li: The packager's index format is fine, but we should include a field for `install_hint` to let customers indicate canary vs. core components. Can you add that?
Priya Khandelwal: Added `install_hint` to index schema and updated installer to honor it as a lower priority indicator (no semantic change if absent).
Marcus Nguyen: I ran the smoke e2e locally on RHEL8 and hit an RPM dependency that wasn't in the shrinkwrap. We should fail more loudly if a required package is missing.
Priya Khandelwal: Preflight now exits non-zero with an explicit message and list of missing package refs. Also added unit tests for that path.
